responsibility: Defines the OpenRISC backend’s target-specific command-line option table and generated state variables. It declares switches that enable or disable hardware divide, multiply, floating-point, double-float, unordered FP comparisons, conditional move, rotate, sign-extension, and immediate-form instructions, as well as the -mcmodel= code-model selection, providing the option metadata that drives backend feature flags such as TARGET_SOFT_DIV, TARGET_HARD_FLOAT, and or1k_code_model.
same_name_distinction: Among the or1k files, this is the generated-option definition file: it declares OpenRISC command-line switches and enums such as -mhard-div, -msoft-float, -mcmodel=, and feature toggles that become TARGET_* flags and or1k_code_model. Unlike or1k.h and or1k.cc, it does not define or implement backend mechanics directly, and unlike or1k.md it does not encode instruction patterns.
